nodes.summary: Each decoded block consumes at least its delimiter bit.
nodes.title: Decoded block count is at most the input length

nodes.summary: Lists of vertices below `n` have a quadratic certificate bound when their length is at most `n`; no unary Nat encoding is used.
nodes.title: Quadratic encoding bound for vertex lists below $n$

nodes.summary: A list in the first field of a decoded pair is raw-input bounded.
nodes.title: Length bound for a list in the first field of a decoded pair

nodes.summary: A successfully decoded list has at most one element per input bit. No canonicality assumption on the element payloads is needed.
nodes.title: Decoded list has at most one element per input bit

nodes.summary: The middle list of a right-associated triple is raw-input bounded. Used for TSP matrix rows and SET COVER set occurrences.
nodes.title: Length bound for the middle list of a decoded triple

nodes.summary: Successful pair decoding exposes the exact raw component payloads. This includes payloads which are not canonical encodings.
nodes.title: Decoded pair exposes its raw component payloads

nodes.summary: A list in the second field of a decoded pair is raw-input bounded.
nodes.title: Length bound for a list in the second field of a decoded pair

nodes.summary: A list of binary naturals with at most `m` bits per entry has the stated framed length bound.
nodes.title: Framed length bound for lists of $m$-bit naturals

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
